description_en: Gets information about video and audio files
kebab_example: aliyun ice get-video-list --cate-id 781111 --status Uploading,Normal --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T12:59:00Z --sort-by CreationTime:Asc --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVideoList

parameters.help_en:
The status of the video. You can specify multiple video statuses and separate them with commas (,).

Valid values:

PrepareFail: The file is abnormal.

UploadFail: The video failed to be uploaded.

UploadSucc: The video is uploaded.

Transcoding: The video is being transcoded.

TranscodeFail: The video failed to be transcoded.

ProduceFail: The video failed to be produced.

Normal: The video is normal.

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.

Preparing: The file is being generated.

Blocked: The video is blocked.

checking: The video is being reviewed
parameters.help_zh: 视频状态。支持获取多个状态的视频，多个状态之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime的结束时间，需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the results. Valid values:

CreationTime:Desc (default): sorts results in reverse chronological order.

CreationTime:Asc: sorts results in chronological order
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 列表页大小。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

MediaList.description_en: The information about the audio and video files

items.description_en: The information about the audio or video file

AppId.description_en: The ID of the application. Default value: app-1000000

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the audio or video file was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the audio or video file

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the audio or video file

ModificationTime.description_en: The time when the audio or video file was updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

Size.description_en: The size of the source file. Unit: bytes

Snapshots.description_en: The array of video snapshot URLs

items.description_en: The URL of the video snapshot

Status.description_en:
The status of the video.

Valid values:

PrepareFail: The file is abnormal.

UploadFail: The video failed to be uploaded.

UploadSucc: The video is uploaded.

Transcoding: The video is being transcoded.

TranscodeFail: The video failed to be transcoded.

ProduceFail: The video failed to be produced.

Normal: The video is normal.

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.

Preparing: The file is being generated.

Blocked: The video is blocked.

checking: The video is being reviewed

Tags.description_en: The tags of the audio or video file

Title.description_en: The title of the audio or video file

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值：
true： 成功
false：失败

Total.description_en: The total number of audio and video files that meet the conditions
